How the tests were run

Backend testscd backend && npm test: Jest + Supertest, each suite on its own in-memory MongoDB (mongodb-memory-server)
Browser checksAutomated with Puppeteer driving Microsoft Edge (headless) against the production build of the frontend and the real backend on an in-memory MongoDB, on separate ports. Any request to the normal dev ports is blocked, so no real database is touched.

Step 4 — Start/stop timer
